summary: FASE 2 frontend-only E2E testing (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080 + tablet 768) of /pos/caja and /pos/cuentas-por-cobrar plus POS checkout integration. Verified: caja 4 stats & DOP$ math (opening 2000 + cash sales − expenses), expense modal + validation, close/open cycle with 'Último cierre' summary and shift reset, cash-sale checkout updating caja (9,440 -> ventas 9,440 / caja 11,440), CxC generation for link / cxc / transferencia methods with badge increments (pos-cxc-badge + nav-cxc-badge), checkout blocked when caja closed (no sale recorded, cart preserved), transfer proof validation (pos-transfer-error then success after upload), CxC seed state (2 pending / DOP$ 17,500 / 1 paid Ana), filters Pendientes/Cobradas/Todas, Marcar cobrado, detail modal with items + Confirmar pago (no cash impact) and Cobrar en efectivo (+5,500 to caja), sidebar & top-bar navigation, and Fase 1 regressions (qty stepper, 10% discount, category filter, search, dashboard period filters + chart). No JS console errors in any run. Backend testing skipped as requested (no backend).

issues: Table (min-w-720px) forces horizontal scroll: 'Estado'/'Acción' columns (incl. Marcar cobrado button) are off-screen with no visible scroll affordance
Fecha cells wrap into 4-5 lines ('20 ago de 2026, 05:20 p. m.') making rows very tall; consider a short date format or stacked card layout on <lg
Customer name cell wraps ('Cliente Mostrador', 'María Fernández') even though there is spare horizontal space — Cliente column too narrow / could use whitespace-nowrap

action_items: Business-logic decision needed: table action 'Marcar cobrado' hardcodes method 'efectivo' (CxcPage handleMark(r,'efectivo')). Verified a TRANSFERENCIA receivable (María 5,500) marked from the table adds 5,500 to 'Ventas en efectivo'/'Efectivo en caja', inflating the cash drawer for a non-cash settlement. Consider defaulting to 'confirmado' for transferencia/link, or requiring the modal's explicit 'Cobrar en efectivo'.

Minor: reopening the caja (openRegister) wipes the expenses array, so the previous shift's expenses are lost/not archived (only the aggregate survives in lastCloseSummary). Consider archiving shifts if historic reporting is planned.
Design polish on CxC table at tablet width (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: posStore.markReceivablePaid does not guard against re-paying an already 'paid' receivable; calling it twice on the same id would add its amount to cashSales again. UI currently hides the button for paid rows, but add a status check in the store.
CxC 'Marcar cobrado' / detail modal actions have no confirmation step and are irreversible (no 'revertir cobro'), which is risky for a cash-affecting action.

posStore persists 'items' (cart) but not 'transferProof'/'paymentReference'; after a reload a transferencia cart silently loses its proof and re-blocks checkout — acceptable but worth aligning partialize with validation state.
CajaPage Stat testids are label-based (data-testid="caja-stat-Efectivo inicial", with spaces/accents). Prefer slugged ids (caja-stat-efectivo-inicial) for stable automation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of 12 scenarios passed (1 transient test-side skeleton timing failure re-verified as PASS)

seed_data_creation: None persisted; used app seed after localStorage.clear(). Test-created data (TEST_Insumos gasto, TEST_LNK-999 receivable) lives only in the throwaway browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All FASE 2 done-when criteria pass. Use localStorage.clear() on /dashboard then navigate. Product cards: [data-testid='pos-product-grid'] [data-testid^='pos-product-'] and wait ~2s (skeleton reappears on category/search change — a short wait causes false 0-result assertions; search 'rostro' correctly returns 2 items with 2s wait). Caja stats selector: [data-testid='caja-stat-<Label>'] p >> nth=1. Dashboard period testids are dashboard-filter-today/week/month/quarter. Cart item sub-elements share the 'cart-item-*' prefix so counting them overcounts. Remaining open questions are business-logic only (Marcar cobrado always credits cash).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found. The single observed logic concern: CxcPage line 128 calls handleMark(r,'efectivo') for the row action, and posStore.markReceivablePaid credits cashSales whenever method==='efectivo', so non-cash receivables settled from the table increase the cash drawer.
